newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Pope leaves Czech Republic after three-day visit.
newsitem.headline: Pope leaves Czech Republic after three-day visit.

text.p: Pope John Paul flew out of the Czech Republic on Sunday after a three-day visit which included a call for a religious revival in the country.
The Pontiff, ending his third visit to Prague since the 1989 fall of communism, left for Rome in a Czech Airlines jet after a rainswept farewell ceremony with Czech President Vaclav Havel.
The Pope said two open-air masses during the visit and attended an ecumenical service in Prague's St Vitus Cathedral.
